rawContent: I think what white people “good” people still don’t get is that the system of policing was built BY US to keep US safe. Yes I get it - your uncle Joe was a great guy and he was a cop - nonetheless, he worked in a system that was about protecting WHITE PEOPLE. #BlackLivesMatter

And I’m thinking yet again of another angle on all these police shootings - what if any of these people are/were hearing impaired? You can’t possibly understand what hysterical out of control reckless police are telling you to do!!! #blacklivesmatter #hearing #executions
